description: This Java class 'ChangeOperation' models different types of change operations (charge, transaction, or term variations) within the loan account domain, providing comparison logic based on effective date, submission date, and creation date.

classes.name: ChangeOperation
classes.description: Represents a change operation in a loan account, which can be a charge, transaction, or term variation, with comparison logic based on effective date and other attributes.

methods.name: ChangeOperation
methods.description: Constructs a ChangeOperation with a LoanCharge.

methods.name: ChangeOperation
methods.description: Constructs a ChangeOperation with a LoanTransaction.

methods.name: isLoanTermVariationsData
methods.description: Checks if the operation involves loan term variations data.

methods.name: isTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the operation involves a loan transaction.

methods.name: isCharge
methods.description: Checks if the operation involves a loan charge.

methods.name: isInstallmentFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an installment fee.

methods.name: getEffectiveDate
methods.description: Returns the effective date of the operation based on its type.

methods.name: getSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the submitted on date for the operation.

methods.name: getCreatedDateTime
methods.description: Returns the creation date/time of the operation.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ChangeOperation with another for ordering based on effective date, disbursement, accrual, submission, and creation dates.
